mechanism: Foscarnet causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia); prednisone immunosuppression increases infection risk and may mask symptoms, while corticosteroids can exacerbate electrolyte disturbances.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (calcium, magnesium, phosphate), and CBC closely; ensure adequate hydration with foscarnet; consider alternative antivirals if possible; use lowest effective prednisone dose.
